response_text: We used the initial MSP value to get PSP’s values by subtracting 0x400 from it. As a result a space for a stack was created which didn’t overlap with the current stack or other memory. This allows us to allocate stack memory lower in memory, accurately and without conflict.\n

**Answer completeness (covers all rubric points)** - The response addresses both required elements: (a) how PSP_val is derived from MSP_init_val and (b) why the initial MSP location is required.
